points.description: States that pandas and koalas are similar because both are specialists with a very narrow diet: pandas eat almost only bamboo and koalas eat almost only eucalyptus leaves, as the article says.

States that pandas and koalas differ from pythons because pythons are generalists, able to live in varied environments and/or eat varied prey, whereas pandas and koalas are specialized; the article lists the python as a generalist.

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the panda–koala similarity (both narrow-diet specialists) and the contrast with pythons (generalists). One correct comparison earns one mark; no comparison or an unsupported answer earns none. Equivalent wording and correct use of article details are accepted.
